verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own docs list ISO 27001 as a supported framework alongside SOC 2 and others. They also describe pre-mapped controls, audit-ready reports and in-platform auditor collaboration, so the core framework support exists. Nothing in the evidence shows ISO 27001 is first-class rather than just mapped, and the only detailed launchpad flow documented is for SOC 2. missing for 10: current Annex A (2022) control set, Statement of Applicability generation, ISO-specific certification-audit artifacts (e.g. Stage 1/Stage 2 support), and independent or hands-on corroboration of ISO 27001 depth.

support.subject: As a security engineer, ISO 27001 is a first-class framework — the current Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability, and certification-audit artifacts are supported, not just mapped

citations.quote: One platform, multiple frameworks: Manage SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and others in one place.
Sprinto is a security compliance automation platform designed to help cloud-hosted companies meet and maintain compliance across standards like SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and more.
Fast-track audits: Automate 80% of manual effort with pre-mapped controls, integrations, and workflows.
work cross-functionally with your team and auditor in-platform.
